blocks.text: 事件经过

inlines.text: 事件经过

blocks.text: 作为常规软件测试的一部分，我们收集了经授权用于该用途的提示词样本，并将其存储在私有的 Hugging Face 仓库中。这些样本来自对 MiniMax M3、GLM-5.2 和 Kimi K2.6 模型的请求，主要集中在 2026 年 6 月 24 日、7 月 4 日、7 月 8 日和 7 月 14 日。

inlines.text: 调查与范围

blocks.text: 根据我们的审查，除本事件外，我们未发现其他提示词泄露的证据。我们正在持续审查受影响的提示词内容，以确定是否泄露了敏感个人信息或其他客户数据。我们将视需要直接联系受影响客户，告知与其相关的调查结果。

blocks.text: 我们已做的改进

inlines.text: 我们已做的改进

blocks.text: 事件发生后，我们加强了围绕开发工作流、凭据和客户数据的管控。这些改进包括：

inlines.text: 事件发生后，我们加强了围绕开发工作流、凭据和客户数据的管控。这些改进包括：
使用限定范围或短时效的凭据，并在支持的情况下采用无密钥访问，以降低凭据泄露可能造成的影响。
检查所有拉取请求中是否包含凭据。
将零数据保留（ZDR）设为新账户的默认设置。
更新我们关于使用 AI 编程智能体的开发流程。

blocks.text: We are notifying customers about a security incident involving a subset of prompts submitted to Together AI’s serverless inference service in June and July 2026. An unauthorized party downloaded stored prompt samples after a credential for a private repository was exposed in a public code repository.

inlines.text: We are notifying customers about a security incident involving a subset of prompts submitted to Together AI’s serverless inference service in June and July 2026. An unauthorized party downloaded stored prompt samples after a credential for a private repository was exposed in a public code repository.

blocks.text: We apologize for this incident. We are reviewing the affected data to determine what information was exposed and which customers require direct notification.

inlines.text: We apologize for this incident. We are reviewing the affected data to determine what information was exposed and which customers require direct notification.

blocks.text: What happened

inlines.text: What happened

blocks.text: As part of routine software testing, we collected prompt samples authorized for that use and stored them in a private Hugging Face repository. The samples came from requests to the MiniMax M3, GLM-5.2, and Kimi K2.6 models, primarily on June 24, July 4, July 8, and July 14, 2026.

inlines.text: As part of routine software testing, we collected prompt samples authorized for that use and stored them in a private Hugging Face repository. The samples came from requests to the MiniMax M3, GLM-5.2, and Kimi K2.6 models, primarily on June 24, July 4, July 8, and July 14, 2026.

blocks.text: During development of our public GitHub repository, xorl, an AI coding agent committed a credential that provided access to the private Hugging Face repository. Our automated scanning detected the exposed credential, and we reverted the commit.

inlines.text: During development of our public GitHub repository, xorl, an AI coding agent committed a credential that provided access to the private Hugging Face repository. Our automated scanning detected the exposed credential, and we reverted the commit.

blocks.text: During the exposure window, an unauthorized party obtained the credential and used it to download the stored prompt samples. The party subsequently searched those samples for credentials to other services and tested whether those credentials were valid. Five of the credentials tested were canary credentials associated with a Dragos security experiment.

blocks.text: We have no reason to believe the unauthorized party has leaked this data further and understand that it has now been deleted.

blocks.text: Investigation and scope

inlines.text: Investigation and scope

blocks.text: We have worked with an external forensic investigation firm and law enforcement to investigate the incident.

inlines.text: We have worked with an external forensic investigation firm and law enforcement to investigate the incident.

blocks.text: Based on our review, we have not identified evidence of additional prompt leakage beyond this incident. Our review of the affected prompt contents is ongoing to determine whether sensitive personal information or other customer data was exposed. We will contact affected customers directly as needed with the findings relevant to them.

blocks.text: Changes we have made

inlines.text: Changes we have made

blocks.text: Following the incident, we strengthened controls around development workflows, credentials, and customer data. These changes include:

inlines.text: Following the incident, we strengthened controls around development workflows, credentials, and customer data. These changes include:
Using scoped or short-lived credentials, and keyless access where supported, to reduce the potential impact of credential exposure.
Checking all pull requests for credentials.
Making zero data retention (ZDR) the default setting for new accounts.
Updating our development processes governing the use of AI coding agents.
